minimumBundleDraft.statement: Actions can preserve or degrade relation/coherence.
Degradation without restoration cannot be called moral good.
Restoration requires a source or operation not reducible to unrepaired damage itself.
Justice requires damage/cost to be truthfully accounted for.
Mercy requires restoration without falsifying justice.
Coherence is the integrated state where truth, relation, justice, mercy, and restoration do not contradict.
